name: 自由记 Freenote
description: 查询 Freenote 个人记录和总结。公司老板还可查询员工企业记录、读取归档正文并导出 ZIP。通过 WorkBuddy 完成 OAuth 授权。
description_zh: 查询 Freenote 个人记录和总结。公司老板还可查询员工企业记录、读取归档正文并导出 ZIP。通过 WorkBuddy 完成 OAuth 授权。
description_en: Read your Freenote records and summaries. Company owners can also read employees' company records and export them as ZIP files. Authorize through WorkBuddy.
examples_zh: 查看我的账号状态和剩余额度。
列出我最近五条记录或总结，包含标题、时间和来源。
将我最近一条有可读总结的记录整理成 Markdown 笔记。
查看某个员工全部日期的转写、纠错和 AI 总结。
导出某位离职员工的企业历史记录为 ZIP。
examples_en: Show my account status and remaining quota.
List my five most recent records or summaries, including title, time and source.
Turn my most recent record with a readable summary into a Markdown note.
Read an employee's company transcripts, corrections and AI summaries across all dates.
Export a former employee's company recording history as a ZIP file.
